tasks.label: run: vision demo (camera + detection)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup vision_demo.launch.py'

tasks.label: colcon: test
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && cd ${workspaceFolder} && colcon test --packages-select hikrobot_camera_ros2 --event-handlers console_direct+ && colcon test-result --all'

tasks.label: run: camera (mock backend)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch hikrobot_camera_ros2 camera.launch.py'

tasks.label: run: camera (real MVS backend)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch hikrobot_camera_ros2 camera.launch.py backend:=mvs'

tasks.label: run: preview (mock, uncalibrated)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup preview.launch.py backend:=mock'

tasks.label: run: preview (mock, synthetic calibration)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup preview.launch.py backend:=mock calibration_file:=${workspaceFolder}/install/dmu_vision_bringup/share/dmu_vision_bringup/config/mock/test_calibration.yaml'

tasks.label: run: calibration (needs real camera + checkerboard)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 launch dmu_vision_bringup calibration.launch.py backend:=mvs size:=8x6 square:=0.025'

tasks.label: run: image viewer (rectified)
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 run image_view image_view --ros-args -r image:=/camera/image_rect'

tasks.label: run: vision health check
tasks.command: bash -lc 'source /opt/ros/jazzy/setup.bash && source ${workspaceFolder}/install/setup.bash && ros2 run dmu_vision_tools vision_health_check --measure 5'
